mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the permission matrix definition allows Alloy to construct access-control scenarios that violate the principle of least privilege. The LeastPrivilege assertion checks that all permitted operations conform to the matrix; without it, the assertion becomes vacuous.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_PermissionViolation { some a: AuditEntry | a.accessor.userRole = HospitalAdmin and a.accessType = ReadRecord and a.outcome = Permitted }

mutation_targets.rationale: This fact enforces that clinical roles can only succeed if they have care-team membership. Removing it allows the model to construct clinical-access audit entries with Permitted outcome and no backing care-team membership, which is exactly what OwnershipBasedAccess should reject.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AccessWithoutTeam { some a: AuditEntry | a.accessor.userRole in ClinicalRole and a.accessType = ReadRecord and a.outcome = Permitted and no m: CareTeamMembership | m.clinician = a.accessor and m.patient = a.patient and m.status = "active" }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the append-only constraint on notes allows two distinct ClinicalNote atoms to be equal, violating the immutability invariant. The assertion checks that all notes are distinct.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MutableNotes { some disj n1, n2: ClinicalNote | n1 = n2 }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the append-only constraint on audit entries allows two distinct AuditEntry atoms to be equal. The assertion ensures all audit entries are immutably distinct.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MutableAuditEntries { some disj a1, a2: AuditEntry | a1 = a2 }

mutation_targets.rationale: This fact restricts administrators to ListAudit operations. Removing it allows the model to place an administrator in a ReadRecord or AddNote operation, violating content-blindness. The assertion should catch any admin performing non-audit operations.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AdminReadsRecord { some a: AuditEntry | a.accessor.userRole = HospitalAdmin and a.accessType = ReadRecord }

mutation_targets.rationale: This fact enforces that ListAudit is performed only by administrators. Removing it allows a clinical-role user to perform ListAudit, violating endpoint-level access control.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_ClinicalListAudit { some a: AuditEntry | a.accessor.userRole in ClinicalRole and a.accessType = ListAudit }
